verdict.rationale: Nitrokey has a dedicated PIV documentation page and advertises certificate-based login to computers and network services. Its docs cover Windows login with Active Directory, Linux PAM, OpenVPN and on-device key generation, but these workstation and VPN guides sit under the OpenPGP card feature, not PIV. The only code-signing evidence is a community report of using the separate Nitrokey HSM with OpenSC, not this key. Missing for 10: substantive PIV-specific documentation beyond a page title, documented PIV code signing on the Nitrokey 3, explicit evidence that PIV workstation/VPN login works, independent hands-on corroboration of the PIV applet.
